scenarios.title: Storage path regression after firmware change
scenarios.summary: A synthetic hybrid-cloud cluster shows repeated storage-path resets and elevated application latency after a firmware rollout.
scenarios.query: storage path reset node-042 firmware 4.8.17 checkout latency

logs.text: node-042 kernel storage path reset detected on adapter 2 after firmware 4.8.17
node-042 multipath queue retry threshold exceeded; latency 920 ms
node-017 informational health check completed with no path errors

incidents.text: A firmware rollout caused intermittent storage path resets. Draining one affected node stopped retries while the prior firmware was restored.
Database latency increased after an unindexed query; remediation required a query plan change, not a node restart.

runbooks.text: For a single degraded storage path: verify replica health, dry-run node drain, drain one node, observe path reset rate for five minutes, then restore or roll back.

proposed_action.expected_outcome: Path resets fall below 2/min and checkout latency falls below 300ms.

scenarios.title: Firmware drift with no safe automatic action
scenarios.summary: Two hosts report parity warnings, but inventory sources disagree about their firmware state. The correct behavior is to abstain and open an investigation.
scenarios.query: parity warning firmware inventory conflict nodes 077 081

logs.text: node-077 corrected memory parity warning after maintenance restart
node-081 firmware inventory agent reported version unknown

incidents.text: When inventory sources disagree, operators must refresh authoritative inventory before changing firmware or draining capacity.

runbooks.text: Do not remediate firmware from stale inventory. Open an investigation, refresh the hardware inventory source, and require owner confirmation.

proposed_action.expected_outcome: Create an evidence-bound investigation without changing infrastructure.

scenarios.title: Approved restart fails verification and compensates
scenarios.summary: A workload restart is approved, but the independent health check remains red, forcing compensation and escalation.
scenarios.query: payments worker memory pressure restart health check remains red

logs.text: payments-worker-3 memory pressure 94 percent and queue age 190 seconds
payments-worker-3 restart accepted but downstream health probe remains red

incidents.text: A restart acknowledged by the platform did not restore service because a downstream dependency remained unhealthy. Verification prevented repeated restarts.

runbooks.text: Restart one worker only after checking queue redundancy. Verify queue age and downstream probe. If either remains unhealthy, restore the previous replica and escalate.

proposed_action.expected_outcome: Queue age falls below 30 seconds and all dependency probes become green.
